<decision>
Implemented block-first rule precedence, a strict greater-than $500 threshold, and zero prior successful payments as “new.”

<risk>
Country codes are compared exactly as supplied; malformed or differently cased inputs are outside the typed contract.

<verified>
Ran node smoke.ts and five assertion scenarios covering neutral, threshold, review, repeat-customer, and block-precedence behavior.

git diff -- impl.ts artifacts/notes.md && git status --short
git add impl.ts artifacts && git commit -m "Implement ticket" && git push -u origin HEAD
